name: Oh My Secuaudit
description: Security audit skill collection — SAST, DAST, external software analysis, architecture review, dataflow clustering, assessment-as-code methodology
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**.

- **Skills** (7): `external-software-analysis` (External software analysis workflows for binaries/packages (decompilation, reverse engineering, static analysis, fuzzing, and evidence collection)), `sec-audit-dast` (DAST/ASM workflow for external asset discovery, probing, and scanning with SARIF output), `sec-audit-static` (Static code security audit playbook (SAST, SCA, secret detection) with standardized JSON outputs and reporting), `sec-cluster` (Dataflow-based code clustering for security assessments), `sec-reference-retrieval` (Query multi-source AppSec catalogs (CWE / OWASP Cheat Sheet Series / GitHub Advisory Database / AppSec.fyi) for a…), `security-architecture-review` (Security architecture review for codebases, producing Data Flow Diagram (DFD) with trust boundaries, Attack Flow overlay, scoped attack…), `security-testing-as-code` (Transform security assessment deliverables from static documents (Word/Excel/portal) into version-controlled, executable projects)

Installs with `claude plugin install oh-my-secuaudit@claude-community` from `windshock/oh-my-secuaudit` (`plugins/oh-my-secuaudit`).
